name: BeAthlit Lake Run - December 2026 Edition
description:
What is Lake Run?
Lake Run is BeAthlit's signature multi-event running series, designed around Bengaluru's most beautiful water bodies. Each edition takes place at a different lake — giving runners a fresh experience, a new trail, and a new story every time.
More than just a run, it's a series. A journey. Every event you complete counts toward an annual tally — and hitting 5 in a year earns you the most coveted medal in the series: Legends of Lake composite medal.
BeAthlit Monthly Lake Runs
We are bringing Lake Runs in a new format to make it easy for everyone to participate and appreciate the lakes. As lake authorities don’t allow any structure inside or near the lakes, this will resemble a community run.
What's the new format:
Choose a lake at which you want to run
Register
Report at the lake and collect your t-shirt on the day of the run between 7 am to 9 am (as lakes close by 10 am)
Run on your own, with family or with friends. Record the run on any of the fitness apps like Strava, Garmin, Google Fit, Nike Run Club, RunKeeper, etc
Show the proof of your run to our team, collect the medals, and celebrate.
Runners who finish 5 lake runs till Dec 2026 will earn a composite medal called 
“Legend of Lakes”
.
Run Locations (Choose Your Lake)
Jakkur Lake
Sarakki Lake
Sankey Tank Lake
Agara Lake
How It Works
Register for the event
Choose your preferred lake
Arrive at the lake entrance between 6 AM to 9 AM
Report to our team and collect your T-shirt
Complete your 1.6K / 3K / 5K /10k run
Track your run using Strava
For kids running with an accompanying adult, the adult’s Strava activity will be considered valid
Show your activity to our team at the lake
Collect your Medal
Important Guidelines
Complete your run at the lake you select during registration from 6 AM- 9:30 AM.
Strava activity is required for medal eligibility
Distance must be clearly visible in your activity
No Bibs will be provided
No hydration or on-route support will be available
Our team will be present at each lake entrance for verification and distribution

name: REVOLUTION RUN 2027
description:
REVOLUTION RUN 2027
Run for a Greener Bengaluru
Date: Sunday, 31 January 2027
Venue: Bhartiya City, Bengaluru
Race Start Time: 6:00 AM
Organised by: BYG Events & Sports
About the Event
Get ready to run, inspire and make a difference!
Welcome to Revolution Run 2027 – Run for a Greener Bengaluru, a community-driven running event that brings together fitness enthusiasts, professional runners, beginners, families and people passionate about building a healthier and greener city.
Organised by BYG Events & Sports, Revolution Run is more than just a running event. It is a movement that encourages people to embrace fitness, promote environmental responsibility and create a positive impact on the community.
Whether you are an experienced runner chasing your next personal best, a fitness enthusiast looking for a new challenge, or a family wanting to enjoy an active morning together, Revolution Run has something for everyone.
Set against the vibrant surroundings of Bhartiya City, Bengaluru, participants can choose from multiple race categories and experience the energy, excitement and spirit of community running.
Race Categories
* 10 KM – Revolution Challenge: For experienced runners and those looking to push their limits.
* 5 KM – Community Run: Perfect for fitness enthusiasts and regular runners.
* 3 KM – Fun Run: Ideal for beginners and anyone looking to enjoy running.
* 1.5 KM – Family Run: A fun-filled experience for families and children.
Our Green Commitment – One Registration = One Tree
At Revolution Run, every step contributes towards a greener tomorrow.
Our sustainability initiatives include:
* One Registration = One Tree: Every registration contributes towards our tree plantation initiative.
* Sustainable Race T-shirts: Participant T-shirts made using recycled materials.
* Responsible Waste Management: Promoting waste segregation and recycling throughout the event.
* Green Awareness: Encouraging participants to adopt environmentally responsible habits.
What Participants Can Expect
* Professionally organised running experience.
* Well-marked race routes.
* Hydration and medical support.
* Race-day event support and volunteer assistance.
* Finisher medals.
* Official event T-shirt.
* An energetic community atmosphere.
* An opportunity to be part of a meaningful green initiative.
Be Part of the Revolution!
Every kilometre counts. Every participant matters. Every registration makes a difference.
Come with your friends, family and running buddies. Let’s run together, celebrate fitness and take one more step towards a greener Bengaluru.
REVOLUTION RUN 2027 – RUN FOR A GREENER BENGALURU
Run for Fitness. Run for Community. Run for the Planet.
Organised by BYG Events & Sports

name: AGI 10K RUN
description:
The AGI 10K Run returns for its 3rd edition on Sunday, 31 January 2027, and this year we run for our hearts. Powered by Akash Cardiac Centre, the race takes you through the streets of Devanahalli, starting and finishing at the Akash Campus in North Bangalore.
Choose your challenge: a timed 10K or 5K with cash prizes and age-group honours, or a non-timed 3K for families and first-timers. Every runner earns a premium finisher’s medal, a T-shirt and refreshments, plus 50% off select cardiac services.
Every step counts, so lace up and Run For Your Heart.
1. Registration
Registration is confirmed only after full payment.
There are no cancellations or refunds.
BIBs cannot be transferred, and you cannot change category.
T-shirt sizes follow the details given at registration and cannot be swapped later.
 
2. Eligibility
Minimum age is 12 years for Heart 10K and Pulse 5K, and 8 years for Happy Heart 3K.
Participants confirm they are medically fit to run.
3. BIB collection
BIBs are given out only at the pick-up venue you selected.
There is no BIB distribution on race day.
4. Race day
Reporting time is 5:30 AM for all categories, and the race starts at 6:00 AM.
Wear your BIB on the front, clearly visible. Anyone running with someone else’s BIB will be disqualified.
Follow the instructions of marshals, volunteers and medical staff.
5.Finisher benefits
Every finisher gets a premium medal and refreshments.
6.Health & safety
Participants run at their own risk. The organisers, sponsors and partners are not responsible for injury, illness or loss of belongings.
7.Conduct & media
Cutting the course or unsportsmanlike behaviour will lead to disqualification. Please keep Devanahalli and the AGI Campus clean.
Photos and videos taken at the event may be used for promotion.
By registering, participants accept these terms.
